0x000BEE:
An isolated South Pacific island near the Marquesas where Meteor 3 fell in New Era 179. The <EOTI Organization> based itself there to study it; its <EOT> and anti-alien weapons research became the <DC>'s power base.
Heavily fortified for <EOT> secrecy with air-centered defenses, it was largely destroyed in the <L5 Campaign>, then rebuilt by the GS as its base, 'Grand Christmas.'
0x0018E9: Extra Over Technology Inquiry Organization. Founded in New Era 180 to analyze the <EOT> in 'Meteor 3,' the meteorite that fell on Aidoneus Island. Brilliant scientists gathered worldwide under Bian Zoldark, the genius of his age. It became the parent body of the <DC>, whose scientists continued developing weapons and systems.
0x00276D: The upheaval caused by the Inspectors in New Era 187-188. Aliens auditing Earth's civilization, they judged humanity's insatiable fighting spirit a threat to galactic order and schemed to control the Earth Sphere. Invading in 187, they blitzed the Moon and North America, but the mass Einst outbreak forced them off Earth, and the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom annihilated them.
0x0032C5: AMN: Armored Module Network, a system that rapidly relays combat data between <Armored Module>s and shares it across units. The former <EOTI Organization> and <DC> pursued it, but slow mutual data exchange kept it from adoption.
0x003A04: Short for Mass Amplitude Preemptivestrike Weapon: a weapon for wide-area first strikes. By area of effect they divide into straight-line, circular, and impact-scatter types. Also called 'map weapons.'
0x004925:
Formed in New Era 184, when ten space colonies united as a nation, from the Earth Federation space forces stationed there. Nominally separate, it is effectively under Federation Army control, which some resent. Its demanding space combat role makes its personnel highly skilled.
In late New Era 186 it declared war on the Federation alongside the DC. Holding most spaceborne forces, it quickly seized space, then supported DC ground operations. After commander Maier V. Branstein fell it surrendered - in truth to prepare for the alien war - and many units joined 'Operation SRW,' the L5 Campaign's final operation.
Postwar its leaders were replaced and its name became a formality, but it still forms most of Earth's space forces.
0x005D26:
A humanoid-weapon pilot training institution once in the Federation Army, founded alongside the <Aggressors>. It first retrained conventional pilots for machines like the <Personal Trooper>, but its aim changed once Adler Koch took charge.
Rather than convert veterans, Adler sought pilots raised from the start for humanoid weapons. He secretly gathered orphans with superior reflexes and dynamic vision, had Dr. Agilla Setme alter their memories, and through conditioning, drugs, and training tried to swiftly create humans specialized in piloting and combat: the 'Boosted Children.' They were sorted into metal-named classes - Aurum (gold), Argent (silver), Bronzo (bronze), Hierro (iron), Latooni (brass) - and adjusted for various roles.
Only a handful excelled. The inhumane program and poor results became a scandal and the School was dissolved, but the Boosted Children's training continued under the <DC>.
0x006BD2: A barrier projected from the Tower of Harmony over all <La Gias>, supplying mana worldwide and limiting great magic.
0x0071E3: An uprising by the <DC> from late New Era 186 into 187. It seized bases across the Earth Sphere in a blitz using <Armored Module>s, but leader Bian Zoldark died in the Hagane's raid on Aidoneus Island; the DC fell into chaos and lost.
0x0083BF: An over-technology research institute in Colorado, founded in New Era 171 by Bian Zoldark. Alumni include robotics authorities Jonathan Kazahara and Erik Wan. Though most members left for the <EOTI Organization>, it continues <EOT> research, <Tesla Drive> improvements, and Grungust-series development. Named for Nikola Tesla and Wilhelm Reich; Kazahara now directs it.
0x008C88: A substance discovered in Meteor 3, absent from the Solar System and found sealed in clearly artificial containers. Each piece is a rice-grain-sized metal holding enormous energy. Six existed; the <EOTI Organization> analyzed them, and some reached the Federation Army through deals involving Major Ingram Prisken of the SRX Project. The Tronium Engine extracts this virtually inexhaustible energy as motive power; its conversion per unit time is immeasurable. Since Earth-level materials cannot withstand the output, limiters are installed, and raising output also speeds energy generation, making control extremely difficult.
0x00A571:
A spherical space fortress used by the <Aerogaters> as their base in the <L5 Campaign>. Formally the "Automated Planet Neviim"; "White Star" was Earth's codename. With mobile weapon plants, a spaceport, a 1G housing block, and farms, it is virtually a mobile colony; one unproven theory says it was to carry warlike humans to the Aerogater homeworld.
Crippled by the Operation SRW allied fleet's assault, it passed to Federation control. In New Era 187 the invading <Inspectors> seized it as their base. It later fused with Neue Regisseur, leader of the <Einst>, becoming the giant weapon Stern Regisseur, and vanished after a fierce battle with the Kurogane and Hiryu Custom.
0x00B16C: I<Elemental> machines bound to high spirits that choose their own operators, built by Langran to guard all <La Gias>. Four exist: Wind, Flame, Water, Earth.
0x00B9BD: Short for 'Re-Mind Control': per-mission memory adjustment and mental control of subjects under memory manipulation, like the <Boosted Children>. Heavy rewriting risks mental collapse, so data is changed gradually. <Boosted Children> keyed by emotions - love, friendship, hostility, grudges - easily exceed their specs.
